title: Browser — remote headless-browser chrome
description: Full browser chrome for a REMOTE headless browser: Chrome-style multitab strip (each tab its own remote page), omnibar with search-or-URL detection, bookmark bar, history view (localStorage-persisted), favicons with globe fallback, busy/live badges, an AI agent-activity side panel, save-screenshot action, and a frame viewport that forwards clicks/typing/keys/scroll into the remote page. The backend is INJECTED via a small per-tab BrowserAdapter (state/screenshot/act/close/agentLog/saveShot): point configureBrowser at a real headless-Chromium service (e.g. Playwright behind an authed route — any site renders, no X-Frame-Options problem), wire a live MJPEG screencast with configureScreencast (poll fallback otherwise), or keep the bundled offline canvas demo renderer that fakes per-tab viewports + an action log so the whole chrome works with zero backend. Self-contained: shell inspector hooks are inert seams in lib/host.ts.
